You are the technical face of our client in the room.<\/p><br><p><strong>Your tasks include:<\/strong><\/p><ul><li>Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations.<\/li><li>Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders.<\/li><li>Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases.<\/li><li>Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments.<\/li><li>Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions.<\/li><li>Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples.<\/li><li>Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity.<\/li><li>Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides.<\/li><\/ul><\/p><br><strong>Your profile<\/strong><p><p>You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff.<\/p><br><p><strong>Experience &amp; Education<\/strong><\/p><ul><li>More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement.<\/li><li>Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences.<\/li><li>Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns.<\/li><li>Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud.<\/li><li>Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus.<\/li><li>Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example Munich or Frankfurt).<\/li><li>Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%).<\/li><li>Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock).<\/li><li>Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations.<\/li><li>Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies.<\/li><\/ul><p><strong>Skills &amp; rescuing.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Next Moonfarian:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You bring six or more years of design experience, with a portfolio consumer brand \u2014 or you can show that you understand that register and want to work in it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You bring an AI-native mindset \u2014 you use AI tools in your day-to-day and you packaged or installed.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You bring hands-on command of Figma and the Adobe suite&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You give feedback as well as take it, and you can explain a design decision to a non-designer without defensiveness or jargon.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You can work at pace inside a regulated industry and you see compliance as a design constraint rather than a blocker.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;This role is unlikely to be a good match if you:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Need a fully written brief before you can start. A good deal of this work begins as a conversation and a deadline.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Prefer to direct rather than make. This is a hands-on role and the person in it designs every day.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Are happiest producing high volumes of performance creative. Our channel mix is deliberately narrow, and quality of execution matters more here than volume of message.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Find restraint frustrating rather than freeing. Our brand is built on hairline rules, whitespace and type weight rather than colour and ornament.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Prefer to work at arm&#39;s length from the business. You will sit with Fund Marketing, Investor Relations and Compliance constantly.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Invest in Yourself:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Ownership and Impact: &lt;\/strong&gt;You are empowered to bring ideas, make decisions, and see your work directly contribute to Moonfare&#39;s success.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Transparent Environment: &lt;\/strong&gt;We believe in open communication. Our solutions empower stores to manage orders seamlessly through multiple channels, including our in-house app, API integration, and devices pre-installed with our software. Additionally, we provide tools to maintain and update product catalogs, ensuring accurate inventory for consumers. The technology we\u2019ve developed enables our partners to pick the correct items swiftly while keeping inventory data current, optimizing both efficiency and accuracy.&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll do?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Software Engineer at Deliveroo, your individual work contributes to achieving goals in and across your team. You will report to managers and group leads and together deliver the results.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Technical Execution:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will improve code structure, have an impact on architecture, and review code of any scope produced by your team.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll aim to simplify the maintenance and operation of production systems, visibility, operational readiness, and health of your team&#39;s systems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Collaboration &amp;amp; Leadership:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As well as leading from the front regarding technical execution, you&#39;ll build relationships with other engineering teams and, identify collaboration opportunities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll own larger pieces of work, assist with design and technical \/ implementation choices and influence the roadmap within your team.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will take an active role in the hiring process and conducting engineering interviews. Together, we\u2019re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Data &amp;amp; Science Org&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Deliveroo we have an outstanding data science organisation, with a mission to enable the highest quality human and machine decision-making. We work throughout the company - in product, business and platform teams - using analysis, experimentation, causal inference and machine learning techniques. We are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Deliveroo.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Data Scientists at Deliveroo report into our data science management team, and we have a highly active data science community, with guest lecturers, study groups, mentorship programmes, a robust technical review process, and plenty of opportunities to learn new things. Data Scientists can equally progress as technical leads (individual contributors) and as people managers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science, many are not. We celebrate difference and have a dedicated data science diversity committee.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As an Economist at Deliveroo you will help scale our business and improve the experience for restaurants, riders, and eaters. Using experimental or observational data, you will get to help answer questions like:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Which markets\/cities should we enter next?&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;How can we incentivise good rider behaviour?&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;What is the business impact of exclusive deals we have with restaurants?&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Can the Delivery food market sustain multiple players?&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;What are the trade-offs we face when choosing between growth and profitability? How should we decide between them?&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;What is the optimum selection and variety of restaurants?&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;What impact do online reviews have?&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;How will a change in the user interface affect customer choice behaviour?&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The work you will do will have a direct, measurable impact on the bottom line of the company.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Masters Degree or PhD in Economics or Econometrics (preferred)&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Always curious and willing to learn new skills&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;A problem solver with a deep analytical mindset&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business-relevant economic problems&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;A critical thinker with very strong attention to detail&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Proficiency with analytical tools like R\/Python and familiarity with SQL&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Ideally industry experience since the completion of your academic career&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Excellent people skills \u2014 you\u2019ll be meeting with stakeholders to translate business needs into economic problems&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Deliveroo these are just some of the tough problems we are solving - and there is no challenge that cannot be yours. The scope for growth and personal impact is enormous.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Why Deliveroo&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Workplace &amp;amp; Benefits&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we\u2019re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;Join us to redefine the future of on-demand delivery. To do this, we&#39;re building a world-class Finance Engineering (FinEng) organization across all global markets we support at DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. in which each of our product managers plays a critical role in helping to define and execute our vision to move money accurately and at scale across every market we operate in and ensure finance and accounting compliance. As we grow, billions of dollars in money movements flow through our platform every year and our team makes sure every one of them is understood, trusted, and correctly reflected in the financial books.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;About the Role&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Product Managers on the Finance Engineering team need a systems-oriented mindset, platform thinking, and strong cross-functional collaboration. In this role, you will define the strategy and vision for systems that track billions of dollars in company-wide money movement, translate transactions into accounting entries, and accelerate the financial close. You will build scalable, audit-ready automation for complex, high-volume financial activity.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is an opportunity to reshape modern accounting by applying AI to reconciliation, investigations, and incident detection and mitigation. Your products will form a critical part of the company\u2019s financial infrastructure and help earn the confidence of leadership, auditors, and regulators.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;You&#39;re excited about this opportunity because you will\u2026&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive the product definition, strategy, and long-term vision for accounting automation. You own the roadmap&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build systems that track billion-dollar-level money movements across the entire company and automatically convert them into accurate accounting entries&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Reinvent and accelerate the accounting close process, reducing manual effort and shortening close timelines&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Champion AI-driven approaches to transform close reconciliation, financial investigations, and incident detection and mitigation&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with FinEng, Accounting, and Finance leaders to translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into scalable, automated products&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, accountants, and operators&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Communicate product plans, benefits, and results to key stakeholders including the leadership team&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;We&#39;re excited about you because\u2026&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have a track record in product management, including driving product strategy, vision, and roadmap alignment&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have built complex, back-end, data-intensive, or platform products. Ideally in fintech, payments, accounting, or financial systems&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have a strong grasp of accounting concepts (e.g. double-entry, ledgers, reconciliations, the close process) and how financial data flows through complex system&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You do your best work with range: global platform thinking alongside the accounting reality of a specific brand or market&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;re an execution power-house who thrives in ambiguity and operates at the lowest level of detai&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You are excited about applying AI\/ML to real-world financial problems such as reconciliation, investigation, and incident mitigation&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have experience presenting business reviews to senior executives&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have empathy for the users you build for, including accountants, controllers, and finance operators&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You are motivated by building financial infrastructure that works across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;Why Join Us?&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Deliveroo, you\u2019ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that\u2019s constantly evolving. We\u2019re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83d\udd27 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83c\udf31 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83e\udde0 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83c\udf0e A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. \ud83d\udcb0 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you\u2019re rewarded for the impact you make.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u27a1\ufe0f Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine\u2014our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence \u2013 all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Clients value Baringa\u2019s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly \u2013 all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Certified as a&amp;nbsp;&lt;em&gt;Great Place to Work &lt;\/em&gt;around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the &lt;em&gt;Financial Times &lt;\/em&gt;in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by &lt;em&gt;Forbes &lt;\/em&gt;for four consecutive years as one of the World\u2019s Best Management Consulting Firms.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Our Analyst Roles&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our Analyst roles give you the opportunity to build a career in an award-winning management consultancy firm while contributing to meaningful client work from day one. You will develop an understanding of the consulting business model as well as hands-on experience across the consulting project lifecycle, from understanding client challenges and analysing evidence through to developing recommendations and supporting delivery.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As an Analyst you will join a real consulting team, working and learning from experienced consultants, with exposure to meaningful client work alongside structured development to help you learn more about Baringa and working as a consultant.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;About the Government team at Baringa&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our Government team helps departments, agencies and public services solve complex problems and deliver better outcomes for citizens. Our work spans Central Government, Home Affairs, and Health and Public Infrastructure, from redesigning services and strengthening operations to using data, technology and AI to improve decisions and delivery.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We work on Government\u2019s most complex changes, partnering with departments across Whitehall and the wider public sector, using our skills in Strategy and Business Cases, Project Delivery, Operational Delivery, DDaT and Government Commercial.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The UK public sector is navigating significant challenges and opportunities, including the delivery of major national priorities and missions. As our Public Sector team continues to grow, we are looking for curious and motivated Analysts who are excited to learn, contribute and develop with us. You do not need previous consulting or public sector experience \u2013 we are interested in how you approach problems, learn new things and apply your skills to real-world challenges.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;What you will be doing&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We will embed you in client projects as part of a consulting team, working alongside experienced consultants to learn while delivering real client outcomes. You will not be expected to know how to do all of this from day one. You will be supported throughout and given opportunities to build your skills through meaningful project work.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Depending on the project you join, you may have the opportunity to:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Analyse quantitative and qualitative information to identify insights, trends and opportunities for improvement.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Explore how data, digital technology, automation or AI could help improve public services.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop recommendations and delivery plans, considering how people, technology and data work together.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the development of client materials, including presentations, reports, workshop outputs and project updates.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to meetings and workshop discussions, helping to capture key points, actions and decisions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Learn how consulting teams work together to solve problems, structure ambiguous challenges and communicate clearly with clients and colleagues.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Examples of the type of projects you could be working on are:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support transformation projects that help government and public sector organisations improve services, strengthen operations and deliver better outcomes for citizens.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Help review how services and processes work, from frontline delivery through to internal operations, identifying opportunities to make them simpler, more effective or more resilient.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to digital, data and analytics work, including projects that use AI or data-led approaches to help clients make better decisions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the development of business cases and funding proposals, helping clients assess different options and make evidence-based decisions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Help design how services should operate, looking at how people, processes, technology and data come together to deliver better results within operating models and service blueprints.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support commercial and procurement activity, such as researching suppliers, comparing options and helping prepare materials for decision-making.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;What are we looking for?&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We welcome applications from students across a broad range of academic disciplines, including STEM and non-STEM subjects, and are particularly keen to hear from students who enjoy solving complex problems using evidence, data, technology and creative thinking. You do not need to have previous experience in consulting or the public sector - what matters most is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in helping public sector organisations solve complex challenges.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for people who are excited by the opportunity to learn how consulting teams work, contribute to meaningful client projects and develop their skills in a supportive environment. You may be a good fit if you bring:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Structured problem solving&lt;\/strong&gt;, with the ability to break down unfamiliar questions and identify what matters.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Data analysis skills&lt;\/strong&gt;, and comfort working with data to surface insight and support evidence-based recommendations.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Digital and AI literacy&lt;\/strong&gt;, with genuine curiosity about AI and its practical application, and a foundational understanding of how to use these tools responsibly and ethically.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Interest in policy, government and public service&lt;\/strong&gt;, and how national priorities translate into delivery on the ground.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Commercial and financial curiosity&lt;\/strong&gt;, with an interest in how money, value and delivery decisions shape public services, and comfort working with numbers to support them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Clear communication skills&lt;\/strong&gt;, including the ability to explain ideas simply and structure your thinking in writing and conversation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;A collaborative approach&lt;\/strong&gt;, with enthusiasm for working in teams and learning from others.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Willingness to learn and adapt&lt;\/strong&gt;, particularly in a fast-paced project environment where priorities can evolve.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Attention to detail and ownership&lt;\/strong&gt;, taking pride in the quality of your work and following through on tasks.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;A proactive attitude&lt;\/strong&gt;, with the confidence to ask questions, contribute ideas and get involved.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We do not expect you to have all the answers from day one. We are looking for potential, enthusiasm and a genuine interest in developing your consulting skills while contributing to work that matters.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;What&#39;s in it for you?&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;An Analyst role at Baringa is what you make it.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a permanent role where you will gain real project experience alongside structured coaching, training and development. You will build your analytical, communication and problem-solving skills while learning how to support clients, work within high-performing teams and grow as a consultant.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will be part of a collaborative, supportive environment where you can learn from experienced consultants, explore different types of public sector work, and build a long-term career with Baringa.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Requirements&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Applicants should have a strong academic record or equivalent experience, with an interest in consulting and public sector work. Applicants must have the permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future and be eligible for a UK Security Check (SC) clearance. All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Please note we\u2019re unable to sponsor individuals for this opportunity.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Key dates&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 0, 0);&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;TextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8&quot; We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot; data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;An award-winning workplace&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;You can be a part of our \u2018Great Place to Work\u2019 \u2013 with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all.\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.baringa.com\/en\/impact\/awards\/&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Click here&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202fto see some of our recent awards and how we\u2019ve achieved this.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Using business as a force for good.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559738&amp;quot;:200,&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(208, 0, 111); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Join us&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence \u2013 all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Clients value Baringa\u2019s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly \u2013 all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Certified as a&amp;nbsp;&lt;em&gt;Great Place to Work &lt;\/em&gt;around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the &lt;em&gt;Financial Times &lt;\/em&gt;in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by &lt;em&gt;Forbes &lt;\/em&gt;for four consecutive years as one of the World\u2019s Best Management Consulting Firms.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Our Graduate Analyst Programme&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you&#39;ll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you&#39;ll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you&#39;re a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re looking for &lt;strong&gt;Graduate Analysts&lt;\/strong&gt; to join our &lt;strong&gt;Products &amp;amp; Services&lt;\/strong&gt; practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you&#39;ll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The business units currently hiring are:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Technology, Media &amp;amp; Telecoms&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Adam to confirm&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Consumer Products &amp;amp; Retail&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Customer expectations are in flux. Commerce straddles the physical and digital worlds. Inflation is fuelling economic uncertainty. Supply chains are stretched. And sustainability is in the spotlight. In these exceptional times, we use our deep industry knowledge and pragmatic transformation experience to help consumer products and retail companies transform to remain relevant today and thrive into tomorrow.\u202f\u202f&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Data analysis and modelling, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees: Supply Chain, Business, Operations Management&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Industrial Manufacturing&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We partner with our Manufacturing clients to shape the future - securely, sustainably, and at scale. Our team bring expertise in industrial performance, operational resilience, and the transformation of complex manufacturing ecosystems. We work with leading manufacturers across automotive, aerospace &amp;amp; defence, industrial engineering and advanced manufacturing, helping them improve performance, build resilience and deliver sustainable growth through practical, hands-on transformation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Data analysis, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication, Adaptability, Proactive curiosity, Interest in Manufacturing.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees: &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;So, what&#39;s in it for you?&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You\u2019ll join with a cohort of our Graduate Analysts. As a cohort, you will participate in our Analyst Development Programme. Our programme is designed to develop the client, commercial and people skills that you need for a successful career at Baringa.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will join our Global Analyst Community, connecting Analysts with one another to share their experiences and lessons learnt, whilst also gaining knowledge and skills from experienced Baringa people&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You decide on the development you need. We invest in you, to ensure you remain the best in the business, through formal training and qualifications, coaching and mentoring.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You can talk to anyone in the business. There are no barriers, and everyone is accessible, from our Analysts to our Partners. Out Partner to consultant ratio of 1:10, means you get to learn and work alongside our Directors and Partners on a daily basis.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We\u2019re proud to put people first with wellbeing at the forefront of our culture, one example of this is that every employee receives \u00a3300 a year to put towards their wellbeing!&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme, which seeks to ensure that everyone has a stake in the success of the company.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break - As such we have introduced the \u2018Re-charge\u2019 benefit meaning Baringa will offer all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lastly, we recognise the importance of work-life balance and we know that the \u2018ideal\u2019 balance will vary from person to person and will change at different stages of our working lives.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #00358e;&quot;&gt;Requirements&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Applicants must have&amp;nbsp;the&amp;nbsp;permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559738&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&lt;u&gt;Please note we\u2019re unable to sponsor individuals for this opportunity.&lt;\/u&gt; We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559738&amp;quot;:200,&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(208, 0, 111); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Join us&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence \u2013 all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Clients value Baringa\u2019s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly \u2013 all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Certified as a&amp;nbsp;&lt;em&gt;Great Place to Work &lt;\/em&gt;around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the &lt;em&gt;Financial Times &lt;\/em&gt;in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by &lt;em&gt;Forbes &lt;\/em&gt;for four consecutive years as one of the World\u2019s Best Management Consulting Firms.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Our Graduate Analyst Programme&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you&#39;ll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you&#39;ll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you&#39;re a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re looking for &lt;strong&gt;Graduate Analysts&lt;\/strong&gt; to join our &lt;strong&gt;Financial Services&lt;\/strong&gt; practice.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Financial Services is being reinvented. AI is transforming how businesses operate, customer expectations are rising and established players are under pressure to grow, innovate and perform at pace. That\u2019s where Baringa comes in. Across Banking, Capital Markets and Insurance, we work alongside senior leaders at some of the world\u2019s leading financial institutions to tackle the challenges that matter most. From unlocking new sources of growth and reimagining how businesses operate, to harnessing AI and responding to rapidly changing markets, we help turn complex problems into meaningful, lasting impact. You\u2019ll bring together bold strategic thinking, analytical rigour, an AI-native mindset and a bias for action - helping clients move from ambition to results. It\u2019s challenging, fast-moving work at the intersection of strategy, technology and transformation, with the opportunity to make an impact from the very start of your career.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Skills: Tech and Data (AI) Experience (where applicable), Structured problem solving, Data analysis, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication, Adaptability, Commercial and financial curiosity.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees: STEM, Business, Politics, Law, Geography&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;So, what&#39;s in it for you?&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You\u2019ll join with a cohort of our Graduate Analysts. As a cohort, you will participate in our Analyst Development Programme. Our programme is designed to develop the client, commercial and people skills that you need for a successful career at Baringa.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will join our Global Analyst Community, connecting Analysts with one another to share their experiences and lessons learnt, whilst also gaining knowledge and skills from experienced Baringa people&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You decide on the development you need. We invest in you, to ensure you remain the best in the business, through formal training and qualifications, coaching and mentoring.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You can talk to anyone in the business. There are no barriers, and everyone is accessible, from our Analysts to our Partners. Out Partner to consultant ratio of 1:10, means you get to learn and work alongside our Directors and Partners on a daily basis.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We\u2019re proud to put people first We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot; data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;An award-winning workplace&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;You can be a part of our \u2018Great Place to Work\u2019 \u2013 with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all.\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.baringa.com\/en\/impact\/awards\/&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Click here&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202fto see some of our recent awards and how we\u2019ve achieved this.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Using business as a force for good.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559738&amp;quot;:200,&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(208, 0, 111); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Join us&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence \u2013 all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Clients value Baringa\u2019s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly \u2013 all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Certified as a&amp;nbsp;&lt;em&gt;Great Place to Work &lt;\/em&gt;around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the &lt;em&gt;Financial Times &lt;\/em&gt;in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by &lt;em&gt;Forbes &lt;\/em&gt;for four consecutive years as one of the World\u2019s Best Management Consulting Firms.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #00358e; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;Our Graduate Analyst Programme&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you&#39;ll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you&#39;ll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you&#39;re a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re looking for &lt;strong&gt;Graduate Analysts&lt;\/strong&gt; to join our &lt;strong&gt;Energy &amp;amp; Resources&lt;\/strong&gt; practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you&#39;ll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The business units currently hiring are:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Commodities Energy &amp;amp; Trading&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Our commodities and energy trading focused team operates across all major commodity and energy companies in Europe, the US and Singapore. From metals traders and miners, through oil majors, freight and shipping specialists to power and gas traders. Our people bring deep industry expertise to help our clients translate strategy into action, to enter new markets, build new trading capabilities, and to revolutionize their IT landscapes. &lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&quot;From day one I have worked directly with clients on their complex trading transformation journeys. This has involved face-to-face engagement with our internationally based clients, visiting client site within weeks of starting at Baringa.&quot;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired skills: Problem solving, IT interest, data skills, interest in commodity markets, personable and confident on client site&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees: &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;Engineering, Economics, Data science&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Energy Products&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We turn Baringa&#39;s deep energy market expertise into trusted data, insights and software products that our clients rely on as they navigate the energy transition. Our team create the market simulations and forecasts used by investors, developers, and utilities around the world to support strategic decision-making. We combine experts covering energy markets, data science, software development, and economics to create digestible data-led insight to our clients. Depending on your background you could be working with either our market research, modelling, or communications teams&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Skills: &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;A keen interest in energy markets, comfortable handling large datasets and extracting insight for a wide audience, clear presentation and storytelling ability, programming (e.g. Python, SQL), using AI (for coding, for agentic workflows), experience using numerical models\/simulation, interpersonal skills.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees: STEM subjects, Economics, Operational Research&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Markets &amp;amp; Transactions&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We help investors, developers, utilities, lenders and corporates make well-informed commercial decisions across the energy transition. We combine deep expertise in energy markets and infrastructure with strong commercial and transaction advisory capabilities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our work ranges from market fundamentals analysis, power price forecasting and asset optimisation through to commercial strategy, M&amp;amp;A transactions, financing processes and investment due diligence. We work on some of the energy sector&#39;s most complex and high-profile challenges, helping clients deploy capital, manage risk and unlock value in rapidly evolving markets.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Successful candidates will combine analytical rigour and curiosity with a strong commercial mindset, and an interest in understanding how energy markets, investment decisions and business strategy intersect.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Skills: Commercial acumen and strategic thinking, Quantitative analysis, modelling and data interpretation, Structured problem-solving and critical thinking, Energy market and energy systems knowledge, financial analysis and investment appraisal, Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills, Ability to synthesise complex information into clear recommendations&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees: Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Finance, Business \/ Management, Data Science, Statistics or Operational Research, Other quantitative disciplines.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Economics, Policy, Regulation, and Commercial&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We support clients from policy development to implementation, from regulatory strategies to business case submissions, and from competition cases to expert opinion. Our economists, policy specialists, regulatory experts and techno-economic modellers work alongside governments, regulators, investors and corporates - shaping the frameworks and decisions that underpin multi-billion-pound investment across energy, utilities and wider infrastructure.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Skills: Economic and quantitative analysis, written communication, structured problem-solving, policy &amp;amp; regulatory awareness, interpersonal skills.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees: Economics, Public Policy, Politics\/PPE, Econometrics, Statistics, Finance&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Transition, Assets and Infrastructure&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our Transition, Assets &amp;amp; Infrastructure team helps energy, utilities and infrastructure organisations deliver complex transformation across the full asset asset lifecycle&amp;nbsp; from&amp;nbsp; capital programmes, asset management, operate and maintain and decommissioning.&amp;nbsp; We work with clients to develop their asset strategy, improve the performance of critical infrastructure, deliver large-scale capital investments, shape future operating models, and unlock value through technology, data and AI. Combining expertise in engineering, project delivery, operations, technology and business transformation, we help clients solve complex challenges and deliver lasting outcomes across asset-intensive industries.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Skills: Problem Solving, Curiosity &amp;amp; Learning Mindset, Strong Communication Skills, Analytical &amp;amp; Structured Thinking, Interest in Energy, Infrastructure and Technology&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees: STEM including engineering disciplines, Data Science,&amp;nbsp; etc.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #00358e;&quot;&gt;So, what&#39;s in it for you?&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You\u2019ll join with a cohort of our Graduate Analysts. As a cohort, you will participate in our Analyst Development Programme. Our programme is designed to develop the client, commercial and people skills that you need for a successful career at Baringa.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will join our Global Analyst Community, connecting Analysts with one another to share their experiences and lessons learnt, whilst also gaining knowledge and skills from experienced Baringa people&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You decide on the development you need. We invest in you, to ensure you remain the best in the business, through formal training and qualifications, coaching and mentoring.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You can talk to anyone in the business. There are no barriers, and everyone is accessible, from our Analysts to our Partners. Out Partner to consultant ratio of 1:10, means you get to learn and work alongside our Directors and Partners on a daily basis.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We\u2019re proud to put people first with wellbeing at the forefront of our culture, one example of this is that every employee receives \u00a3300 a year to put towards their wellbeing!&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme, which seeks to ensure that everyone has a stake in the success of the company.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break - As such we have introduced the \u2018Re-charge\u2019 benefit meaning Baringa will offer all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lastly, we recognise the importance of work-life balance and we know that the \u2018ideal\u2019 balance will vary from person to person and will change at different stages of our working lives.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: future.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 0, Baringa will give you&lt;\/span&gt; &lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot; data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;An award-winning workplace&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;You can be a part of our \u2018Great Place to Work\u2019 \u2013 with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all.\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.baringa.com\/en\/impact\/awards\/&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Click here&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202fto see some of our recent awards and how we\u2019ve achieved this.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Using business as a force for good.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559738&amp;quot;:200,&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(208, 0, 111); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Join us&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(208, 0, 111); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Baringa Privacy Notices&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;For UK &amp;amp; EU&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.baringa.com\/globalassets\/careers\/dp-004-ukrpn---uk-recruitment-privacy-notice-pdf.pdf&quot;&gt;UK Recruitment Privacy Notice \/ &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.baringa.com\/globalassets\/careers\/dp-005-eurpn---eu-recruitment-privacy-notice-pdf.pdf&quot;&gt;EU Recruitment Privacy Notice&lt;\/a&gt;, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence \u2013 all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Clients value Baringa\u2019s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly \u2013 all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Certified as a&amp;nbsp;&lt;em&gt;Great Place to Work &lt;\/em&gt;around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the &lt;em&gt;Financial Times &lt;\/em&gt;in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by &lt;em&gt;Forbes &lt;\/em&gt;for four consecutive years as one of the World\u2019s Best Management Consulting Firms.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Our Graduate Analyst Programme&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you&#39;ll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you&#39;ll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you&#39;re a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re looking for &lt;strong&gt;Graduate Analysts&lt;\/strong&gt; to join our &lt;strong&gt;Capabilities&lt;\/strong&gt; practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you&#39;ll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The business units currently hiring are:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Customer&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Imagine a world where customers are delighted, employee engagement soars and costs drop. This is the power of world-class omni-channel experiences. Our expert team anticipates change, crafting innovative solutions that blend seamlessly across all touchpoints. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we transform service delivery, minimising costs while maximising impact. Ready to enhance your market position and unlock unprecedented value? Let\u2019s redefine excellence together.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Skills: Strong communication, teamwork, and relationship-building skills. Structured problem-solving and analytical thinking. A customer-focused mindset and interest in improving customer experiences. AI and digital literacy with a curiosity for emerging technologies. Adaptability, curiosity, and a proactive approach to learning and development.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees: Business Management, Product Design UX &amp;amp; UI, and Marketing&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Enterprise Value Creation&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Every organisation faces moments when it needs to grow faster, operate more efficiently or respond to changing market conditions. Baringa&#39;s Enterprise Value Creation team helps clients navigate these challenges by combining strategic thinking, analytical rigour, AI-native mindset, and practical delivery expertise. We advise executive leadership teams to identify opportunities, solve complex business problems and deliver sustainable improvements in growth, profitability, and performance.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Data analysis, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication, Adaptability, Commercial and financial curiosity.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees: Open to all degree types.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Organisation, People &amp;amp; Change &lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Organisation, People, and Change (OPC) enables organisations to achieve lasting success by putting people at the centre of transformation. With a holistic approach, our team helps clients align their operating models, people strategies, structures, and cultures with their strategic ambitions. OPC ensures organisations are equipped to deliver impact that lasts through an engaged and high-performing workforce.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As part of OPC, you will have the opportunity to work across a range of sectors, helping clients with a range of solutions:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Optimising operations and organisational design: Align business capabilities, processes, and technology with the strategic ambition to drive efficiency and effectiveness.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Unlocking leadership, culture, and workforce potential: Shape future skills, foster an engaged and high-performing workforce, and embed target cultures through people-led experiences.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Crafting and delivering transformation and change strategies: Define the vision, strategic direction, and OKRs to create positive conditions for change, enabling organisations to deliver lasting impact.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Skills: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, Organisation and project management capability, Curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset, AI literacy and an interest in innovation, A genuine passion for consulting and transforming organisations and workforces through meaningful change.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees (not essential): Business management \/ Management and Organisational Behaviour, Psychology \/ Organisational Psychology, Engineering - critical thinking \/ problem solving, Data Analytics \/ Business Analytics.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Supply Chain &amp;amp; Procurement &lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The SCP team helps organisations tackle complex challenges across their supply chains, procurement functions and commercial operations. Working with clients across the public and private sectors, we help organisations navigate an increasingly uncertain world, responding to challenges such as cost pressures, supply chain disruption, changing customer expectations and rapid technological change.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As part of SCP, you&#39;ll work on a diverse range of projects spanning supply chain strategy, procurement transformation, commercial advisory, logistics, and technology-enabled change, as part of either our Supply Chain or Procurement &amp;amp; Commercial practice. Our teams combine analytical thinking, practical problem-solving and deep industry expertise to help clients create efficient, resilient and sustainable organisations that deliver lasting value.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Team collaboration and effective communication, Adaptability and personal resilience, Proactive curiosity, Digital literacy.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees: No degree preference, analytical capabilities are key. If you have commercial acumen this is a bonus. Candidates may benefit from STEM experience, but this is not a requirement.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Data, AI, Solutions &amp;amp; Engineering&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Expertly applied, data and AI empower you to operate smarter, innovate faster and compete harder. Blending exceptional technical skills with deep industry knowledge, our consultants make the possibilities real. We are experts in crafting practical data and AI solutions and integrating these into existing production workflows. Where data and AI requires new scalable technology, we work with you to establish the case for investment. And when new data insights are revealed, we ensure you have the right talent to unlock full value. Whether you are looking to establish a robust data infrastructure, foster a data-driven culture or ensure data and information security and compliance are maintained, we can help.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Skills: Problem Solving, Data Analysis, Data Literacy, Technical Data Skills - BI, Python, Engineering, ML, Other coding languages.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Desired Degrees: STEM, Computer Science, Data Science, Other technical data\/AI degrees&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;So, what&#39;s in it for you?&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You\u2019ll join with a cohort of our Graduate Analysts. As a cohort, you will participate in our Analyst Development Programme. Our programme is designed to develop the client, commercial and people skills that you need for a successful career at Baringa.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will join our Global Analyst Community, connecting Analysts with one another to share their experiences and lessons learnt, whilst also gaining knowledge and skills from experienced Baringa people&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You decide on the development you need. We invest in you, to ensure you remain the best in the business, through formal training and qualifications, coaching and mentoring.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You can talk to anyone in the business. There are no barriers, and everyone is accessible, from our Analysts to our Partners.
