Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;Our architecture and approach&amp;nbsp;is&amp;nbsp;based on silicon photonics. By&amp;nbsp;leveraging&amp;nbsp;the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry\u2014including partners like GlobalFoundries\u2014we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons&amp;nbsp;don\u2019t&amp;nbsp;feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;In 2024,&amp;nbsp;PsiQuantum&amp;nbsp;announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining\u2014and that now is the time to scale.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;PsiQuantum&amp;nbsp;also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies\u2014including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical\u2014to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It&amp;nbsp;represents&amp;nbsp;a fundamental shift\u2014and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be&amp;nbsp;solved&amp;nbsp;any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear&amp;nbsp;path&amp;nbsp;to make it real.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;Come join us.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Job Summary:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are seeking a Senior Photonics Engineer to develop ultra-low-loss optical interface solutions between dissimilar, exploratory, waveguiding platforms. This role combines device concept development, optical simulation, and hands-on experimental validation to assess and mature new approaches for mode conversion and coupling. The successful candidate will combine creativity in photonic device design with strong engineering judgement, identifying solutions that are both high-performing and practical to deploy. Working closely with internal teams and expert external partners, they will help guide the development of advanced optical interfaces. We welcome applicants from both advanced industrial photonics environments and leading research groups who combine strong physical intuition with practical experimental and engineering It uses those forecasts to trade on exchanges and alternative trading venues, and to offer differentiated liquidity directly to clients worldwide. The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 250 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing over 25,000 GPUs with 650 petabytes of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. We are focused on teamwork, and our people collaborate on all aspects of the business, working openly and with respect for each other, our clients and the market. Our culture is non-hierarchical and one where everyone is valued. We strive for excellence in everything we do.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Realtime Analytics and Controls Developer, you will be responsible for the mission control panel for one of the largest trading systems in the world ($250bn-300bn\/day). Your work will have a company-wide impact, with users including Trading Desk, Trading Developers, Quants, CEO, Distribution and Risk.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The goal is to provide clarity about what our trading system (hundreds of thousands of strategies) is doing at any given moment and how it is performing. We supply both high-level and incredibly detailed views, as both are crucial for efficient decision making and spotting issues. In addition to visibility, we are also responsible for trading control mechanisms \u2013 e.g., tweaking limits, starting trading strategies or emergency stopping. These actions are necessary for continued trading, and sometimes need to be taken within minutes, with millions of pounds at stake.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Realtime Analytics and Controls is a small specialist tam which works directly with multiple front office groups. You will be expected to also contribute to the shared software platform that supports this group.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is one of our most people-oriented engineering roles. You should expect to collaborate regularly with your colleagues who are the primary customers of your software, to understand how your design decisions affect their day-to-day work.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Communicate regularly with internal users about their needs and ideas.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Understand workflows of all teams involved in trading.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design, implement and maintain software, including:\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;An Ingestion engines.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Present the data in a clear, useful, and accurate way, in collaboration with frontend developers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain It automates manual business processes, adopts emerging technology such as Gen\/Adaptive AI, and uses Microsoft 365 tooling to make TP and our TP&#39;ers more efficient. It also manages our outsourced Salesforce developers and quality assurance specialists to ensure delivery quality and pace.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/td&gt;\n&lt;\/tr&gt;\n&lt;tr&gt;\n&lt;td style=&quot;width: 100%;&quot;&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As our Salesforce Solution Architect you are a senior member of the in-house Business Systems team and own our customer portals and the end to end journeys that run through them. Your primary remit is to design solutions that let us keep providing outstanding service to investors and IFAs through our digital channels, with streamlined and intuitive UI\/UX that meets industry standards. You have ownership of what gets built and how it is delivered, and you set the governance and principles that keep our systems safe and compliant.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You own the target architecture and standards, and you make sure development across our internal team and partners follows our best practices, supported by robust DevOps and QA frameworks. The role blends requirements gathering and refinement, solution design, prototyping, and oversight of build, release and quality.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/td&gt;\n&lt;\/tr&gt;\n&lt;tr&gt;\n&lt;td and regulatory requirements in what is designed and released - the Salesforce data model, security and sharing, data quality, and GDPR \/ UK GDPR and FCA obligations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set and other systems, so customers never have to repeat information.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own UI\/UX decisions for the portals, and involve investors and IFAs in pilots and customers and colleagues.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Release and quality assurance&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set the release and quality standards the Your career at Twilio is in your hands.&lt;br&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 255, 255);&quot;&gt;.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Hiring and how we work&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 255, 255);&quot;&gt;.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;See yourself at Twilio&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Join the team as Twilio\u2019s next Senior Solutions Engineer, South EMEA.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the job&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This position is needed to enable our customers to build the future of communications. The Presales Engineer is a critical part of the sales team focused on our both New Business and Strategic segments.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Twilio\u2019s Presales Engineers are responsible for delivering the Technical Win and best Product Fit to our customers. They lead the technical pre-sales relationship, drive technical discovery, propose technical architectures, demonstrate the product, anticipate concerns and offer creative solutions. They build customer trust in Twilio\u2019s solutions.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Presales Engineers should be comfortable engaging a CEO or sketching out an API flow on a whiteboard with customer software engineers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In this role, you\u2019ll:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Account Executives to execute pre-sales activities including opportunity qualification, demonstrations, Proof-of-Concept, RFP, design documentation, technical presentations and enablement sessions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Help customers achieve success by leading the technical and product sale, recommending best-practice solutions, and guiding them on how to use Twilio\u2019s APIs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Establish yourself as a trusted advisor to our customers, by taking the lead on understanding customer technical pains through discovery in order to design, demonstrate, and present innovative solutions that solve business challenges.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build and present highly interactive, complex and engaging customer product demonstrations to help showcase the capabilities of Twilio\u2019s Communications Products, while effectively forming strong customer relationships with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be Hands-on, high-energy, passionate, and a creative problem solver, equipped with the knowledge of how to get things done and ability to lead others to success.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Take the initiative to identify and solve problems - both for the customer and within the organization as we grow&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to the broader Twilio Presales Engineering community through knowledge sharing, constructing demonstration materials, and creating reusable presentations&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mentor less experienced Presales Engineers&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Qualifications&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn&#39;t followed a traditional path, don&#39;t let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;*Required:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;8+ years pre-sales experience selling complex, technical products or 10+ years of professional experience supporting technical products coupled with customer facing experience, particularly in delivery or consulting&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent communicator and presenter able to gain audience confidence&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;An engaging storyteller - you can gain audience confidence and communicate complex topics to multiple levels of audience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to build a deep understanding of a customer\u2019s communications needs and guide them to a technical solution&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Previous software development experience or working knowledge in one or more of the following areas:&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Web development (JavaScript, HTML\/CSS, frontend frameworks - As a B-Corp certified company, you\u2019re joining a sustainable business that genuinely cares about our people, our products and our impact on the planet. Our goal is simple: to help dogs live healthier, happier, and longer lives, while leaving humans smiling after every interaction.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019ve come a long way since our co-founders (Kev &amp;amp; Dave), hand delivered the very first Butternut Box. Today, we feed hundreds of thousands of hungry dogs across the UK and Europe - but we won\u2019t stop until we\u2019re feeding dogs everywhere. To get there, we need a team of brilliant people who share that ambition to come and work for us.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019re looking for a hard-working, ambitious and highly analytical Senior FP&amp;amp;A Analyst to join the team here at Butternut Box. You will be comfortable both analysing bulk data and owning projects. In this role, you can expect to:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Run the rolling forecast process. This will involve collating output from our management accounts and business leaders, to understand how deviations from plan impact the P&amp;amp;L + cash over the short, medium and long term.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support budgeting and long range planning processes. Lead defined workstreams within our FP&amp;amp;A cycle.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Run periodic P&amp;amp;L and cash variance analyses, identifying root causes and working with budget owners to implement solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Host 4-weekly periodic business reviews (PBRs) with budget owners. Understand the risks and opportunities facing the business to ensure we are having the right discussions and making timely decisions based on business performance.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work with our commercial teams to understand in granular detail: CPA, future growth rates, retention, channel effectiveness and where to allocate resources, customer profiles, etc.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work with our operational teams to understand in granular detail: unit economics, standard costs, yield, write-offs, OEE, etc.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Model out scenarios for different product \/ market launches and growth initiatives. We are quickly expanding across Europe; this role will help us prepare for new market launches and will work closely with international teams to support their success.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Present analysis to senior leadership and prepare quarterly board materials, including ad-hoc deep dives such as sensitivity analyses, margin drivers and working capital.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own processes and team goals. Use AI and automation to make our reporting faster and sharper.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;\ud83d\udc4b&amp;nbsp;A bit about you.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;CIMA\/ACCA\/ACA qualified&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;3+ years post-qualification, 2+ in FP&amp;amp;A&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven self-starter with an entrepreneurial &#39;can do\u2019 attitude&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Highly inquisitive and analytical&amp;nbsp;mind capable of complex problem solving&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Passionate about how numbers can be transformed into key insight&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Advanced financial modelling skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong data manipulation and analysis skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to produce clear graphical data representations&amp;nbsp;&amp;amp; present data in a clear way for finance and non-finance professionals&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent communication skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fine attention to detail with an eagle-eyed ability to spot trends and pick out inaccuracies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A love for all things dogs!&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83c\udf40 &lt;strong&gt;Nice to haves.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;DTC experience, and a familiarity with cohorts, LTV and payback&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manufacturing \/ standard costing experience&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in reporting across multiple markets \/ jurisdictions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2328\ufe0f &lt;strong&gt;Tech stack.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excel + g-sheets&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Datarails (FP&amp;amp;A platform)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;SAP B1 (ERP)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;AI (Gemini, Claude, Gumloop)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;\ud83d\ude4c&amp;nbsp;A bit about what we offer.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Competitive salary&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays) and an additional day for every year of service up to 5 years&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;5 additional, paid &#39;paws&#39; days off per year dedicated to your learning, development or personal wellbeing. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow\u2019s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.&amp;nbsp; Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world\u2019s largest cloud-based scientific research R&amp;amp;D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;iCIMS_Expandable_Container&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;iCIMS_Expandable_Text&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;iCIMS_Expandable_Container&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;iCIMS_Expandable_Text&quot;&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What do we need&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Ready to shape the future of digital transformation across Life Sciences, Chemicals, CPG, Food &amp;amp; Beverage, Fragrance &amp;amp; Flavor, and Energy? Let&#39;s make it happen.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re looking for a high-energy, results-driven &lt;strong&gt;Director, Sales \u2013 EMEA&lt;\/strong&gt; to lead our territory and named account strategy across the region. This role covers the full breadth of R&amp;amp;D, Tech Transfer, and Production \u2014 the entire digital thread from molecule (or formulation) to product.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;To be successful in this role, you should have a background in one or more of the following: Life Sciences (Biology, Chemistry, or related scientific discipline), Chemical\/Materials Science, or direct experience selling enterprise scientific, laboratory, or manufacturing software. Perhaps you were a scientist, engineer, or R&amp;amp;D leader who has since moved into commercial sales \u2014 that path is welcome here.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As Director, you will lead, coach, and develop a regional team of Account Executives, Associate Account Managers, and Inside Sales Representatives (ISRs) across territory and named accounts. This position is central to our EMEA go-to-market strategy and offers significant scope to shape how we grow across a diverse, multi-industry account base.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll build deep relationships with the world&#39;s leading Life Sciences, Pharma, Specialty Chemicals, CPG, Food &amp;amp; Beverage, Fragrance &amp;amp; Flavor, and Energy organizations \u2014 understanding their complex operational and scientific challenges, and delivering solutions that unlock efficiency, quality, compliance, and competitive advantage across their R&amp;amp;D, Tech Transfer, and Production environments.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This role has incredible potential for the right person to shape and grow a region.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you thrive on selling complex, cross-portfolio SaaS solutions into industrial and scientific markets, navigating intricate multi-stakeholder buying processes, collaborating across a large matrixed organization, and leading a team through ambitious growth targets \u2014 this role is for you.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;In this role you will get to&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;:&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;134233117&amp;quot;:false,&amp;quot;134233118&amp;quot;:false,&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335551550&amp;quot;:6,&amp;quot;335551620&amp;quot;:6,&amp;quot;335559738&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Lead Territory &amp;amp; Named Account Strategy&lt;\/strong&gt;: Own the design and execution of a segmented go-to-market approach across EMEA \u2014 balancing territory coverage with focused, strategic named accounts across life sciences\/pharma, specialty chemicals, CPG, F&amp;amp;B, F&amp;amp;F, and energy. Direct how the team allocates coverage and effort across this segmentation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Manage and Develop a Regional Team&lt;\/strong&gt;: Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives, Associate Account Managers, and ISRs \u2014 driving pipeline generation, deal execution, and career growth across the team. Instill a repeatable, metrics-driven sales methodology and hold the team accountable to it.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Sell Across the Full Digital Thread&lt;\/strong&gt;: Position and sell solutions spanning ELN, LIMS, CDS, SDMS, PLM, MES, and Enterprise Cloud\/SaaS platforms \u2014 connecting R&amp;amp;D, Tech Transfer, and Production into a single digital thread. Translate the value of Data Science &amp;amp; Analytics, AI, and agentic\/orchestration capabilities into compelling narratives for scientific, operational, IT, and executive audiences.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Solution Selling with Impact&lt;\/strong&gt;: Coach your team to go beyond the software and solve critical business and scientific challenges \u2014 ensuring pitches are customized to resonate with scientists, plant and quality leaders, IT, and C-suite stakeholders across multiple industries.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Pipeline Generation Powerhouse&lt;\/strong&gt;: Direct pipeline-building efforts across multiple personas within each account, leveraging an established global user base, ABM, cold outreach, warm referrals, partner-sourced leads, and events. Ensure the team has the coverage and tools to execute consistently.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Negotiation &amp;amp; Closing Excellence&lt;\/strong&gt;: Support and unblock complex, multi-national negotiations from discovery to signature, helping the team navigate organizational and procurement complexity to secure high-value, 7-figure+ deals.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strategic Account Management&lt;\/strong&gt;: Build trust and long-term partnerships across named accounts, ensuring solutions align to both scientific\/technical goals and broader operational and business objectives.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Collaborate Across Siemens&lt;\/strong&gt;: Work closely with the broader Siemens Digital Industries Software organization \u2014 including adjacent business units, industry verticals, and shared account teams \u2014 to bring the full weight of the Siemens portfolio to bear on customer challenges and expand deal scope.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Leverage Partners &amp;amp; Channels&lt;\/strong&gt;: Working with our Partners &amp;amp; Channels leader to build and activate relationships with systems integrators (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, TCS) and technology partners (e.g., AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Snowflake, GCP) to extend reach, accelerate deal cycles, and co-sell into strategic accounts.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Driving Process &amp;amp; Execution&lt;\/strong&gt;: Follow a best-in-class enterprise sales framework to build a scalable, repeatable success model \u2014 coaching the team in best practices to maximize efficiency and win rate.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Cross-Team Collaboration&lt;\/strong&gt;: Partner closely with marketing, product, customer success, and partners to deliver a seamless customer experience and drive sustained regional growth.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;ABC \u2014 Always Be Curious&lt;\/strong&gt;: Stay ahead of industry trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies (especially in automation, orchestration, and AI) across every vertical you cover.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We are looking for&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt; someone with significant sales leadership experience across Life Sciences, Specialty Chemicals, CPG, or adjacent process\/scientific industries \u2014 someone equally comfortable engaging Senior Leadership, C-suite, R&amp;amp;D, Manufacturing, Quality, and IT stakeholders, and influencing multi-dimensional decision-making across a matrixed, multi-country region.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;re entrepreneurial, curious, and have a strong track record in complex enterprise SaaS sales \u2014 ideally across data management, laboratory\/manufacturing informatics, automation, orchestration, or AI solutions. You&#39;re comfortable selling into accounts where budget isn&#39;t pre-established, and you know how to build the business case that creates it.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The key skills we are looking for:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience across Life Sciences\/Pharma and at least one adjacent industry (Specialty Chemicals, CPG, Food &amp;amp; Beverage, Fragrance &amp;amp; Flavor, or Energy)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep familiarity with the R&amp;amp;D-to-Tech-Transfer-to-Production digital thread&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working knowledge of relevant solution categories: ELN, LIMS, CDS, SDMS, PLM, MES, Enterprise Cloud\/SaaS, Data Science &amp;amp; At Faire, we&#39;re using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town \u2014 we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. This is a role for someone who has already mastered them. As a Senior Account Executive (L3), you will be a trusted advisor to Upmarket brands across Central &amp;amp; Northern Europe, helping them unlock wholesale growth on Faire and driving incremental GMV at scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This role is a blend of strategic thinking and high-velocity sales execution. You will own a complex, high-value portfolio of brands across your geos, proactively identifying and activating the best-fit brands for Faire. You bring a strong commercial mindset \u2014 comfortable from C-level to operational stakeholder \u2014 and you use AI, data, and sharp instincts to outperform.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a stellar performer: someone who has finished top 3 in their org, qualified for President&#39;s Club or All-Stars, and is hungry to do it again in a market that is genuinely early and genuinely exciting.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;You&#39;re excited about this opportunity because...&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have been top of the leaderboard before and you want to do it in a market that isn&#39;t fully built yet \u2014 where your territory becomes the foundation others inherit&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You are energised by fast-moving, ambiguous environments and see AI as a genuine force multiplier, not a buzzword&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You want to sell something that actually matters \u2014 levelling the playing field for independent retailers against e-commerce and big-box giants is a mission you can get behind&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You want to work alongside a tight-knit team of high performers who share wins loudly, debug losses together, and hold themselves to a standard most sales teams only talk about&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You are curious by default \u2014 you dig until you understand, and you bring that intellectual rigour to every deal&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll Do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Identify and win the right opportunities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage a high-value book of business across Central &amp;amp; Northern Europe with the goal of maximising the incremental GMV that new Upmarket brands bring to the Faire platform&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set your own sub-targets, hold yourself accountable, and know exactly what levers to pull when performance is under pressure&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Use business data, category insights, AI-powered tooling, and your own market knowledge to build a pipeline that is both high volume and high quality&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support new brands through their first quarter on Faire \u2014 ensuring they understand the platform and are set up to receive orders and grow&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Lead a best-in-class upmarket sales cycle&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead every customer interaction with a personalised, insight-led approach \u2014 understanding each brand&#39;s unique business and shaping Faire&#39;s value proposition to their specific problems&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Navigate multi-threaded deals with confidence: from C-suite vision conversations to operational onboarding with sales and marketing teams&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop tailored onboarding plans that balance near-term activation with long-term platform success&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Make independent, well-reasoned decisions on when to advance a deal and when to pass \u2014 and own the outcome either way&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Stay resilient and input-focused when performance is challenging; model the standard for the team&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Be the expert on your markets&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be solution-oriented to common objections and geo-specific blockers \u2014 size the opportunity, identify what&#39;s needed, and act on it with product and leadership&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Understand how competitors and industry players operate and articulate Faire&#39;s key differentiators with precision&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Research trends, industry events, and key account signals across Central &amp;amp; The window to solve it is now.<br \/><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. Brands like Macy\u2019s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;For more information: &lt;a href=&quot;http:\/\/www.mirakl.com&quot;&gt;www.mirakl.com&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Mirakl in Numbers:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\ud83d\uddd3\ufe0f Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\ud83d\udc65 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\ud83c\uddeb\ud83c\uddf7 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\u2699\ufe0f 5 Saas Solutions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Our Values:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We&#39;re proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\ud83d\udca1&lt;strong&gt; Work Hard Together:&lt;\/strong&gt; Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\ud83c\udfc6 &lt;strong&gt;Get Things Done: &lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\ud83d\ude80 &lt;strong&gt;Go Above &amp;amp; Beyond:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp; We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\ud83c\udf93 &lt;strong&gt;Succeed Through Expertise:&lt;\/strong&gt; Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\ud83e\udd1d &lt;strong&gt;Satisfy &amp;amp; Empower Clients:&lt;\/strong&gt; We&#39;re committed to our clients&#39; success&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Team You&#39;ll Join&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll join the Product team of Mirakl Connect, the platform that helps brands and sellers grow their sales across marketplaces and other sales channels. You&#39;ll work closely with the VP Product Connect, the Channel Integration PM and the whole Channel Integration squad.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a 6-month internship starting in January 2027. You&#39;ll participate in team rituals, gain autonomy progressively, and have the opportunity to present your work regularly to management, offering strong visibility within the organization.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Your Impact&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Choosing and building the right channels is one of our biggest growth levers. As a Product Manager Intern, your mission will be to help the team prepare and assess new channel opportunities, reduce uncertainty before development starts and contribute to successful integrations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your work will help the squad bring together the key information, questions, risks and opportunities before development begins.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Concretely, you will:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Help pre-qualify channels:&lt;\/strong&gt; Map the marketplace landscape by country and vertical, and contribute to a first-level assessment of each channel: technical integration effort, functional coverage with Mirakl Connect, and business potential (seller demand).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Explore channel requirements: &lt;\/strong&gt;Review channel API specifications and requirements across catalog, offers, orders and logistics, and test them hands-on (e.g. with Postman). With support from the team, identify key questions, dependencies, risks and areas that require further investigation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Prepare build-ready inputs:&lt;\/strong&gt; Turn your analyses into useful inputs for the squad, such as data mappings, process diagrams, edge cases, open questions for channel partners and first drafts of user stories.&quot;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Talk to the field:&lt;\/strong&gt; Interview sellers, Sales and Customer Success teams, and channel partner teams to turn scattered feedback into clear insights and product recommendations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Contribute to channel builds: &lt;\/strong&gt;Alongside the Channel Integration PM and the squad, help refine specifications and user stories, contribute to backlog discussions, answer functional questions and participate in QA and go-live preparation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Build AI-powered tools to scale channel work:&lt;\/strong&gt; Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis and prototyping. For example, you may help create an agent that analyzes channel documentation, a Q&amp;amp;A assistant for Sales and Customer Success or AI-assisted prototypes to explore mappings and integration flows.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What Success Looks Like&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;After 3 months: A broad set of channels pre-analyzed at a high level, with a first assessment of technical integration effort and functional coverage, contributing to channel pre-qualification&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;After 6 months: Several channels analyzed in depth and handed over to the squad as build-ready, an active contribution to channel builds, and at least one AI tool in daily use by the team&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;What You&#39;ll Bring to the Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Profile &amp;amp; Experience&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Currently pursuing a gap year internship or end-of-studies internship (engineering school, business school or university)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong interest in e-commerce, marketplaces and retail&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A structured mindset, with the ability to turn a broad or ambiguous question into a clear and actionable analysis&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A genuine curiosity for understanding how products, processes and systems work&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Previous experience in a start-up or scale up, in e-commerce, consulting, business analysis or project work is a plus, but not required&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Technical Skills&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Hands-on with APIs:&lt;\/strong&gt; You understand what an API is and how systems exchange data, and you can read API documentation and make simple API calls (e.g. with Postman). Familiarity with data formats (JSON, XML) or integration concepts is a plus.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Data and spreadsheet skills:&lt;\/strong&gt; You are comfortable using spreadsheets to analyze, compare and synthesize information. Experience with dashboards or SQL would be a plus.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Hands-on with AI tools:&lt;\/strong&gt; You use AI tools daily and critically to improve research, analysis and product work. Experience creating prompts, automations or agents is a plus.&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Soft Skills&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Curious, proactive and rigorous: &lt;\/strong&gt;You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions and dig until the key unknowns are clarified.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strong communication and collaboration skills:&lt;\/strong&gt; You communicate clearly with different stakeholders, collaborate effectively in cross-functional environments and can summarize complex information into clear, actionable conclusions for different audiences.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Fast learner with adaptability:&lt;\/strong&gt; You pick up new domains quickly and are comfortable learning unfamiliar concepts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Critical thinker:&lt;\/strong&gt; You can challenge assumptions, assess the quality of information and distinguish facts from hypotheses.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Languages&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluent English is mandatory, both written and spoken, as it is our working language with the team and channel partners.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Another European language is a plus.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Compensation&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Monthly stipend range: \u20ac1,200 - \u20ac1,400&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Our Hiring Process&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We warmly encourage you to apply to this role, even if you think you&#39;re not an exact match.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Please click the &quot;Apply&quot; button to submit your application. <\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><h3>Activit\u00e9s<\/h3><ul><li><p><strong>Concevoir et d\u00e9velopper des m\u00e9canismes d\u2019apprentissage d\u00e9centralis\u00e9<\/strong> Il s&#39;agit d&#39;une couche d&#39;intelligence centralis\u00e9e et agnostique des outils, capable d&#39;interagir avec l&#39;ensemble de notre infrastructure (Workday, Data Lake, University, ...) pour faire \u00e9voluer nos interfaces d&#39;une logique de consultation vers une logique d&#39;action.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Dans ce cadre, nous d\u00e9veloppons &lt;strong&gt;DaiLY&lt;\/strong&gt;, notre agent conversationnel RH. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers \u00e0 acc\u00e9der instantan\u00e9ment \u00e0 une information fiable, sourc\u00e9e \u00e0 partir de notre documentation Workday et de nos politiques People.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;D\u00e9j\u00e0 d\u00e9ploy\u00e9 avec succ\u00e8s en France, DaiLY entre dans une nouvelle phase de passage \u00e0 l&#39;\u00e9chelle : extension internationale, industrialisation des \u00e9valuations, am\u00e9lioration continue de nos mod\u00e8les et de leurs qualit\u00e9s et d\u00e9ploiement et int\u00e9gration d\u2019agents autonomes RH.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e d\u00e9veloppeur.se, nous avons besoin d&#39;un.e &quot;&lt;strong&gt;Builder&lt;\/strong&gt;&quot; : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin m\u00e9tier en solution technique, de l\u2019impl\u00e9menter, la qualifier, la d\u00e9ployer et la maintenir dans le temps.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;\ud83c\udfaf VOTRE MISSION&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Nous recherchons un(e) &lt;strong&gt;AI Engineer confirm\u00e9(e)&lt;\/strong&gt; pour participer activement \u00e0 l&#39;industrialisation et au d\u00e9veloppement de DaiLY. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins m\u00e9tiers RH en fonctionnalit\u00e9s IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Pour relever ce d\u00e9fi, vous \u00e9voluerez au &lt;strong&gt;sein d&#39;un collectif d\u00e9di\u00e9&lt;\/strong&gt;, en collaboration directe avec d&#39;autres AI Engineers, un Lead AI Engineer (qui orientera les choix d&#39;architecture globale) et une Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximit\u00e9 vous permettra d&#39;assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l&#39;impl\u00e9mentation technique.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Vous aurez notamment un r\u00f4le cl\u00e9 dans l&#39;\u00e9volution de DaiLY : passer d&#39;un mod\u00e8le de simple consultation (Q&amp;amp;A) \u00e0 un &lt;strong&gt;v\u00e9ritable syst\u00e8me agentique transactionnel&lt;\/strong&gt; capable de d\u00e9clencher des actions concr\u00e8tes (ex : poser des cong\u00e9s dans Workday, s&#39;inscrire \u00e0 des formations via Decathlon University).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83d\udee0 VOS RESPONSABILITES&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;D\u00e9veloppement Agentique &amp;amp; Fonctionnalit\u00e9s&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participer \u00e0 l&#39;extension des capacit\u00e9s de DaiLY vers des actions d&#39;\u00e9criture (write actions) en impl\u00e9mentant des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Impl\u00e9menter des strat\u00e9gies avanc\u00e9es de chunking et de re-ranking pour prioriser les r\u00e8gles sp\u00e9cifiques au domaine RH.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribuer \u00e0 l&#39;optimisation des co\u00fbts, de la latence et de l&#39;efficacit\u00e9 globale du syst\u00e8me en lien avec les \u00e9quipes Plateforme et Infrastructure.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Qualit\u00e9, \u00c9valuation &amp;amp; Observabilit\u00e9 (LLMOps)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;D\u00e9velopper et maintenir la couche de qualit\u00e9 du pipeline RAG multi-agents (Vertex AI Search \/ Discovery Engine).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des r\u00e9ponses et la v\u00e9rification des citations pour garantir la tra\u00e7abilit\u00e9 vers une source de v\u00e9rit\u00e9.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mettre en place des pipelines d&#39;observabilit\u00e9 robustes pour l&#39;\u00e9valuation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Coder des \u00e9valuateurs automatiques bas\u00e9s sur des golden datasets pour it\u00e9rer sereinement et pr\u00e9venir les r\u00e9gressions avant chaque mise en production.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Int\u00e9grer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour prot\u00e9ger le syst\u00e8me et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;S\u00e9curit\u00e9, Cloisonnement &amp;amp; D\u00e9ploiement International&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Access Management (ACLs) : Impl\u00e9menter une gestion granulaire et dynamique des droits d&#39;acc\u00e8s au niveau de l&#39;indexation et du retrieval, garantissant qu&#39;un collaborateur n&#39;acc\u00e8de strictement qu&#39;aux documents RH de son p\u00e9rim\u00e8tre.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Isolation &amp;amp; Multi-tenancy : Mettre en \u0153uvre des strat\u00e9gies de filtrage par m\u00e9tadonn\u00e9es (metadata filtering) en base vectorielle et de cloisonnement (des index et\/ou des mod\u00e8les) pour assurer une \u00e9tanch\u00e9it\u00e9 parfaite des donn\u00e9es entre les diff\u00e9rentes soci\u00e9t\u00e9s fiscales, entit\u00e9s l\u00e9gales et g\u00e9ographies de Decathlon.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support Multilingue : Contribuer \u00e0 l&#39;architecture d&#39;internationalisation de DaiLY en adaptant les pipelines RAG, l&#39;embedding et l&#39;inf\u00e9rence pour maintenir un haut niveau de performance et de pertinence sur une grande diversit\u00e9 de langues.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Produit &amp;amp; Impact Business&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Aider \u00e0 l&#39;analyse des intentions des utilisateurs pour mesurer l&#39;impact de DaiLY.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Traduire, avec l&#39;appui de la Product Manager et du Lead, les enjeux m\u00e9tier en comportements de mod\u00e8les et en m\u00e9triques de succ\u00e8s.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83e\udde0 PROFIL RECHERCHE&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Nous recherchons un profil justifiant a minima d\u2019une premi\u00e8re exp\u00e9rience.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Exp\u00e9rience :&lt;\/strong&gt; Profil confirm\u00e9 justifiant de plusieurs ann\u00e9es d&#39;exp\u00e9rience professionnelle en entreprise (hors stages et alternances) en AI Engineering, ML Engineering ou Software Engineering orient\u00e9 IA. Vous justifiez \u00e9galement d&#39;au moins une exp\u00e9rience concr\u00e8te et r\u00e9ussie de mise en production d&#39;un syst\u00e8me GenAI ou agentique.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stack Technique&lt;\/strong&gt; : Solide ma\u00eetrise de Python, de l&#39;\u00e9cosyst\u00e8me GCP \/ Vertex AI, et des frameworks d&#39;orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex ou ADK).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Expertise LLM &amp;amp; Agentique &lt;\/strong&gt;: Solide ma\u00eetrise des architectures RAG (recherche vectorielle, Vertex AI Vector Search, gestion avanc\u00e9e de m\u00e9tadonn\u00e9es), mais surtout des concepts techniques agentiques : function\/tool-calling, boucles de raisonnement (ReAct, etc.), orchestration de workflows multi-agents, structured output et gestion du contexte\/m\u00e9moire.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Qualit\u00e9 &amp;amp; \u00c9valuation&lt;\/strong&gt; : Capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 diagnostiquer une r\u00e9ponse incorrecte (probl\u00e8me de mod\u00e8le, de &lt;em&gt;retrieval&lt;\/em&gt; ou de donn\u00e9es) et app\u00e9tence pour l&#39;observabilit\u00e9 applicative (SQL \/ BigQuery \/ MLflow).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Langues &lt;\/strong&gt;: Fran\u00e7ais courant obligatoire &amp;amp; anglais professionnel courant (environnement international).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Les plus :&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Connaissance technique approfondie des protocoles A2A (Agent-to-Agent) et MCP.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Exp\u00e9rience de traitement multimodal de documents ou dans des \u00e9cosyst\u00e8mes SIRH (ex: Workday).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Compr\u00e9hension technique des enjeux de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 (RBAC, ACLs, RGPD) appliqu\u00e9s aux LLMs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Connaissance des architectures microservices et conception d&#39;APIs.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83c\udf81 CE QUE NOUS PROPOSONS&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;L&#39;opportunit\u00e9 de d\u00e9velopper un produit d&#39;IA agentique de pointe avec un impact direct sur le quotidien de 100 000 collaborateurs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Un environnement technologique premium (Stack Google Cloud \/ Vertex AI \/ Databricks).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Une politique de t\u00e9l\u00e9travail flexible (2 jours par semaine en remote, le reste dans nos bureaux \u00e0 Paris - Canal de l\u2019Ourcq).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Une culture du &lt;em&gt;delivery&lt;\/em&gt; ax\u00e9e sur l&#39;autonomie, l&#39;intelligence collective et la mont\u00e9e en comp\u00e9tences (accompagnement par un Lead, certifications, formations).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Des avantages attractifs (primes mensuelles\/trimestrielles, actionnariat salari\u00e9).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Une ambiance r\u00e9solument tourn\u00e9e vers le sport (nombreuses corpos, tests produits, pauses d\u00e9jeuner sportives ou non, \u2026)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;DECATHLON DIGITAL&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les fronti\u00e8res et d&#39;offrir des exp\u00e9riences sportives in\u00e9dites. Grid queues stretch for years, land is contested, freshwater is political.<\/p><p>Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on Earth, a vast resource the grid can, by definition, never reach.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>So we flipped the problem. Instead of bringing power to the load, <strong>we bring the load to the power.<\/strong> Our autonomous wind-turbine energy ships chase the wind across the open ocean and convert it on board into what the world needs most: compute first, then e-fuels to decarbonise aviation.<\/p><ul><li><p><strong>70%+ capacity factor<\/strong> \u2014 offshore wind that behaves like baseload<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>~\u20ac50\/MWh<\/strong> target cost for firm, low-carbon power<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Zero<\/strong> grid queue. <strong>Zero<\/strong> freshwater. <strong>Zero<\/strong> land. And the ocean as the heat sink under every rack.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p>Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs (with successful exits) and industrial operators. Backed by major international investors. First demonstrator vessel at sea in late 2027.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>The role<\/strong><\/p><p>This is not a sales job. It's a late co-founder seat. You will own <strong>Offshore Compute<\/strong>, our first and main commercial engine: strategy, product, pricing, customers and the multi-million-dollar off-take deals that put our first fleet to work.<\/p><p>You already know that power and thermal limits are what will stall AI scaling. You're bold enough to believe infrastructure at sea can get around both, and rigorous enough to prove it to a sceptical buyer.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>What you'll do<\/strong><\/p><ul><li><p><strong>Write the go-to-market from a blank page.<\/strong> Build the global commercial roadmap, from first demonstrator workloads to full fleet monetisation.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Land the anchor deals.<\/strong> Negotiate and close off-take agreements, capacity reservations and JVs with neoclouds, AI labs, CSPs and Tier-1 HPC operators.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Turn variable power into a feature.<\/strong> Design offers built for wind-backed power profiles: fault-tolerant batch training, asynchronous inference, dynamic pricing, zero-carbon AI clouds.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Connect the C-suite to the hull.<\/strong> Translate client requirements (SLA, latency, direct-to-chip liquid cooling) into onboard architecture specs together with our marine engineers.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Create a category.<\/strong> Use our advantages \u2014 no grid wait, no freshwater, a direct ocean cooling sink, very low carbon intensity \u2014 to win premium pricing and long-term commitments, and establish floating compute as a new asset class.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Be the face of it.<\/strong> Represent us at the top AI, cloud and infrastructure summits worldwide and make us the reference for next-generation AI energy infrastructure.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>You might be the one if<\/strong><\/p><ul><li><p><strong>You've been in the room where AI capacity gets bought.<\/strong> You've sold, built or run serious infrastructure in the neocloud, AI infra, CSP or hyperscale data center world, and you've closed the kind of deals that move megawatts. We care about what you've shipped, not what your business card said.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>You know GPU economics inside out.<\/strong> H100 \/ B200 \/ GB200 cluster economics, orchestration, workload constraints. And you know the people across the neocloud and AI ecosystem who sign capacity deals.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>You speak the physics.<\/strong> MW-scale power delivery, PUE, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, thermal budgets. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h1>The Role<\/h1><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h1>What You'll Work On<\/h1><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h1>Who We're Looking For<\/h1><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h1>Your Background<\/h1><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Strong PyTorch and the engineering to run your own experiments at scale.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h1>Nice to Have<\/h1><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Scene graphs, multi-object tracking or trajectory forecasting.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Bayesian or probabilistic deep learning.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Robotics or embodied AI.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Simulation for data generation.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h1>What We Offer<\/h1><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Unser Team arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von &lt;strong&gt;Healthcare, Social Media, Strategie, Experience und Influence&lt;\/strong&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Von Z\u00fcrich aus betreuen wir das Healthcare-Portfolio von Ogilvy f\u00fcr die DACH-Region sowie ausgew\u00e4hlte internationale Kund:innen aus den Bereichen Pharma, Biotech und Medizintechnik. Unser interdisziplin\u00e4res Health-Team vereint Account Management, Medical Writing, PR, Digital, Strategie und Kreation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Zum n\u00e4chstm\u00f6glichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir eine:n&lt;strong&gt; Designer\/ Art Director Health (m\/w\/d)&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;in Berlin, Hamburg, Frankfurt\/ Main, D\u00fcsseldorf oder Z\u00fcrich.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;Das bieten wir:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;M\u00f6glichkeit zur Arbeit im Mobile Office (bis zu 100%)&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Nutzung unseres&amp;nbsp;WPP Weiterbildungsnetzwerkes, inkl. LinkedIn Learning&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Unterst\u00fctzung bei der privaten Altersvorsorge und die Gew\u00e4hrung von verm\u00f6genswirksamen Leistungen&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Jubil\u00e4umspr\u00e4mien in Form von zus\u00e4tzlichen Urlaubstagen&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;M\u00f6glichkeit zur Nutzung eines Job Bikes&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Erweiterte Betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit einem zus\u00e4tzlichen Budget von bis zu 300\u20ac im Jahr&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Zugriff auf unser&amp;nbsp;Employee&amp;nbsp;Assistance Programm&amp;nbsp;TELUS Health&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Kostenlose Nutzung der&amp;nbsp;Headspace-App&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Subventionierte&amp;nbsp;Gympass-Mitgliedschaft&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Deine Aufgaben:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Als Art Director Health entwickelst und gestaltest du Kommunikationsl\u00f6sungen f\u00fcr renommierte Kund:innen aus dem Healthcare- und Pharmabereich. f\u00fcr Rx-Produkte&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Gutes Verst\u00e4ndnis f\u00fcr medizinische Inhalte, regulatorische Anforderungen und Review-Prozesse in der In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;amp;index=11&amp;amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;setting a world record in quantum computing performance&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;s1&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0&quot; data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What to expect&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Staff System Architect to be fully dedicated to the SNSPD product line, with a strong focus on leading the technical architecture and roadmap for our next-generation rack-mountable SNSPD (Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector) platform. This role is critical to defining and guiding the technical evolution of our cutting-edge cryogenic photon detection systems, ensuring architectural coherence across hardware, software, and integration domains while supporting our product vision and market requirements.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a proven architect of complex, multi-domain instruments, whether from space systems, astronomical instrumentation, scientific or medical imaging, electron or advanced optical microscopy, semiconductor equipment, or comparable fields who can bring that system-level rigour to our platform.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;s1&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0&quot; data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;TextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0&quot; data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;NormalTextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0&quot;&gt;What you&#39;ll be doing&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In this role, you will be an integral part of the development process for IDQ&#39;s SNSPD platform, with applications across quantum computing, networking, and sensing. You will be at the intersection of quantum photonics, cryogenic systems engineering and embedded systems to create scalable, maintainable architectures for autonomous 24\/7 detector operations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will take ownership of the end-to-end system architecture of the SNSPD platform, ensuring alignment with a shared long-term product vision while translating product requirements into clear system-level designs and specifications. This includes defining system structure, interfaces, and key architectural decisions, as well as driving critical trade-offs across performance, cost, scalability, and integration. You will also align engineering execution with the architectural vision, guiding system integration and resolving complex cross-domain design challenges.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In addition, you will play a key role in shaping the technology roadmap and driving the evolution of the platform, continuously evaluating and introducing new technologies where relevant to maintain innovation and competitiveness.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead system architecture, design decisions, and cross-functional alignment to ensure a scalable and high-performing SNSPD platform&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive technology roadmap, integration, and innovation by evaluating and implementing new technologies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;s1&quot;&gt;What you&#39;ll bring&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are seeking an experienced professional with a Master&#39;s degree (PhD preferred) in physics, electrical engineering, photonics, or a related field, and 7+ years of experience in the design of complex, multi-domain systems, with demonstrated ownership of system architecture. The ideal candidate has architected instruments or platforms of comparable complexity, combining optics or photonics with electronics, mechanics or thermal design, and embedded or software components and has proven experience integrating these technologies into cohesive, high-performing products.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will demonstrate strong technical leadership across multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to clearly communicate complex system architectures to a wide range of stakeholders. This includes ensuring alignment, supporting informed decision-making, and driving successful collaboration across functions to deliver robust and scalable system designs.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Extensive experience in system architecture and multi-domain integration, with strong system-level thinking&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven technical leadership and communication skills, enabling alignment and effective decision-making across diverse teams&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;s1&quot;&gt;You&#39;ll be a great fit with&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Background in domains of comparable complexity: space instrumentation, astronomy, high-end microscopy or imaging, semiconductor or scientific equipment&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with photonics, low-noise electronics, cryogenics, or vacuum systems&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with SNSPDs, single-photon detection, or quantum systems&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience bringing industrialized or rack-mountable systems to market&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What to expect&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Platform Engineering team builds, secures and operates scalable infrastructure supporting cloud-managed SaaS products with on-premises components deployed at customer sites.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As our Staff DevSecOps Engineer, you will provide the technical leadership for our software factory, defining how software is built, secured and released across the organisation. You will own the roadmap, architecture and tooling that enable every engineering team to deliver software securely, consistently and at scale, while remaining hands-on with automation, infrastructure and platform engineering.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Working closely with Architecture, Site Reliability Engineering, Cloud Operations and Product Development, you will drive an automation-first culture where secure software delivery, developer experience and operational excellence are embedded into every stage of the software lifecycle.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Define and evolve the software factory, including CI\/CD platforms, release engineering, developer tooling, Infrastructure as Code, dependency management and software supply-chain security.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Deliver secure-by-default engineering practices through automated security controls, policy enforcement, vulnerability management, compliance automation and AI-driven workflows.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Mentor engineers, establish engineering standards and collaborate across technical teams to deliver scalable, secure and highly automated development platforms.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll be doing&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will lead the design, implementation and operation of the organisation&#39;s DevSecOps platform, ensuring software moves securely and efficiently from commit to production. You will develop reusable CI\/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code modules and self-service developer capabilities that improve productivity whilst maintaining the highest security standards.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own release management, dependency and supply-chain security, security operations and hybrid infrastructure consistency across cloud and on-premises environments. You will also drive the adoption of agentic automation and AI-enabled workflows to reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency and enhance software delivery.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Own the software-factory roadmap, CI\/CD platform, release engineering, Infrastructure as Code, internal developer platform and software supply-chain security.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Embed security throughout the delivery pipeline through automated scanning, policy enforcement, vulnerability management, secrets management and continuous compliance.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Develop agentic automation for pipeline operations, dependency management, release processes and operational support, while providing technical leadership, mentoring and engineering governance.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You are an experienced DevSecOps or Platform Engineering leader with more than eight years of production engineering experience and recent hands-on responsibility for building and operating enterprise-scale CI\/CD platforms.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You have designed production Infrastructure as Code, embedded security into delivery pipelines and delivered measurable improvements across software delivery, release management, dependency governance or vulnerability remediation. You are passionate about automation and continuously removing manual effort through tooling, scripting and intelligent workflows.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;8+ years of production engineering experience with recent hands-on responsibility for enterprise-scale CI\/CD platforms, Infrastructure as Code and production automation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Proven experience embedding security into software delivery through automated scanning, policy enforcement, vulnerability management and measurable operational improvements.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Strong scripting and automation skills, with a demonstrated ability to simplify complex operational processes through reusable tooling and automation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ll be a great fit with&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You have deep expertise in modern software supply-chain security, internal developer platforms and secure software delivery. You understand how to balance developer productivity with governance, compliance and operational resilience, while creating platforms that engineering teams enjoy using.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You bring practical experience of AI-enabled software delivery, modern release engineering and cloud-native platform design, with a passion for building secure, scalable and highly automated engineering ecosystems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Proven expertise in software supply-chain security, including artefact signing, Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), provenance and SLSA principles.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience designing internal developer platforms, self-service engineering capabilities and release management processes, including expedited production releases.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Hands-on experience with agentic automation, AI or LLM security, and intelligent workflow orchestration within modern DevSecOps environments.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;amp;index=11&amp;amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;setting a world record in quantum computing performance&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location:&lt;\/strong&gt; This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Travel:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Job ID:&lt;\/strong&gt; 1919&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA\/LMS in C\/C++\/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode\/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA\/LMS&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Master\u2019s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C\/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP\/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus.
