IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What to Expect&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are seeking a &lt;strong&gt;Senior Mechanical Engineer&lt;\/strong&gt; to join our R&amp;amp;D team in Geneva. In this hands-on role, you will design, validate, and continuously improve mechanical enclosures and subsystems that integrate optical and electronic components for our quantum products.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will take ownership of mechanical solutions from early prototyping through to industrialized product release, with a strong focus on delivering compact, robust, and cost-effective designs. Your work will ensure compliance with dimensional, thermal, and manufacturability requirements, including for highly demanding applications such as cryogenic systems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll be Doing&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will be responsible for the mechanical development of cutting-edge quantum systems, translating requirements into detailed designs and verified assemblies. This includes 3D modelling and documentation, engineering calculations and simulations, and hands-on testing to validate thermal dissipation and mechanical performance. You will collaborate closely with optical, electronic, and system engineers to optimise interfaces and block specifications, and you will engage with external suppliers to prototype and manufacture parts efficiently. As a senior contributor, you will help improve design practices, promote a rigorous engineering approach, and support multiple projects as a mechanical subject-matter expert.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own mechanical design from prototype to industrialised product, including CAD documentation, assembly bring-up, and validation testing&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive thermal management (heat sinking, conduction\/convection, interfaces and materials), dimensional stability, and manufacturability through design, simulation, and optimization, working closely with cross-functional teams and suppliers&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Perform thermal simulation to predict temperatures, gradients, and heat flows; correlate models with lab measurements and iterate designs and their optimization accordingly&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll Bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor\u2019s or Master\u2019s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Microtechnology, or equivalent, and at least five years of relevant experience in mechanical design and product development. You have hands-on experience designing with sheet metal and\/or machined parts, and a strong ability to develop thermal dissipation solutions for compact systems. Familiarity with cryogenic systems is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You are rigorous, organised, and proactive, able to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multidisciplinary and Agile environment. Strong communication skills are essential, with fluency in English required; French is considered a plus.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solid mechanical engineering foundation with proven experience delivering compact, industrial-grade designs&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Structured, collaborative engineer with strong communication skills and a hands-on approach to validation&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Knowledge of applicable norms and compliance requirements, including EMC and electrical\/product safety aspects&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ll be a great fit if:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You bring a track record of taking ownership of mechanical subsystems across multiple development phases\u2014requirements, design, verification, and industrialisation\u2014and you are comfortable acting as the mechanical reference point within a multidisciplinary R&amp;amp;D team. Experience with compact thermal management and exposure to cryogenic constraints are strong assets.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location:&lt;\/strong&gt; This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Travel:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Job ID:&lt;\/strong&gt; 1893&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking &amp;amp; financial institutions from the \u201charvest-now, decrypt-later\u201d threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA\/LMS in C\/C++\/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode\/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA\/LMS&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Master\u2019s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C\/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP\/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C\/C++\/Rust skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Qualifications:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You want to grow into a world-class applied cryptographer by working on real products with demanding correctness and security requirements, and you enjoy the discipline of code that must be provably right.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We Offer:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A career development plan within the IonQ group\u2019s companies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. You will ensure product features are clearly defined, tracked throughout every stage of the product lifecycle and delivered successfully across cross-functional teams. Working closely with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production and Marketing, you will translate market and customer insights into product features for refinement by engineering teams, while leading the triage, planning and coordination of special customer projects. You will help optimise product lifecycle processes, ensuring efficient collaboration, smooth feature delivery and successful execution from concept through to launch.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Own product operations, ensuring features are defined, tracked throughout the product lifecycle and delivered across cross-functional teams.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Translate market and customer insights into product features, while triaging, planning and coordinating special customer projects.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Partner with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production and Marketing to optimise product lifecycle processes and drive efficient product delivery.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll be doing:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;You will take ownership of the operational delivery of product management, ensuring products and features progress efficiently from validated requirements through development, industrialisation and commercialisation. Acting as the day-to-day product decision-maker within defined boundaries, you will drive cross-functional alignment, maintain product data integrity and coordinate delivery across multiple teams to ensure products are launched on time and to a high standard. This role is integral to enabling the Product team to scale effectively, providing operational ownership and supporting the successful delivery of an expanding product portfolio.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Own the operational delivery of product management, ensuring features progress from validated requirements through development, industrialisation and commercialisation.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Drive cross-functional alignment, maintain product data integrity and coordinate timely delivery across the product lifecycle.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Act as the day-to-day product decision-maker within defined boundaries, enabling the Product team to scale beyond a single Product Manager.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll bring:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;In this role, you will take ownership of feature delivery from end to end, defining requirements and acceptance criteria, coordinating engineering handovers, validating delivery and supporting successful commercial launches. You will manage non-standard sales opportunities by assessing feasibility, making configuration decisions within agreed boundaries and documenting exceptions, while ensuring full traceability from customer requests through to delivered capability. Working closely with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production, Marketing and Sales, you will coordinate cross-functional activities to remove blockers, maintain an accurate and prioritised Jira backlog, and respond to product enquiries from Sales. You will also prepare products for launch through documentation, training, pricing and sales enablement, maintain up-to-date product documentation, communicate complex photonic, cryogenic and networking architectures to a range of stakeholders, and represent the product in customer-facing activities including pre-sales support, technical discussions and trade shows.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Own end-to-end feature delivery, from requirements definition and engineering handover through to delivery validation, commercial launch and ongoing product documentation.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Coordinate cross-functionally with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production, Marketing and Sales, while managing Jira backlog integrity, product enquiries and non-standard sales opportunities.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Support successful product adoption by communicating complex technical architectures, ensuring launch readiness, providing pre-sales support and representing the product in customer discussions and at trade shows.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ll be a great fit with:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;The ideal candidate will hold a Master&#39;s degree in Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Microengineering or a related technical discipline, combined with an action-oriented mindset and the confidence to make decisions in an environment of uncertainty. You will be able to understand and reason about complex hardware products involving photonics, cryogenics and networking technologies, while communicating effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders. You will be comfortable representing products in customer-facing situations, including technical discussions, pre-sales meetings and trade shows, and have a strong understanding of manufacturing environments, including industrialisation constraints, production realities and supply chain considerations. You will also be confident resolving conflicting priorities, negotiating with stakeholders and developing deep expertise in quantum technologies, supported by advanced Jira proficiency, including workflow configuration, automation rules and custom field management.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Master&#39;s degree in Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Microengineering or a related technical discipline, with the ability to make product decisions autonomously within defined boundaries.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Strong technical, commercial and customer-facing communication skills, with experience discussing complex hardware products and representing products in pre-sales meetings and trade shows.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Advanced Jira expertise, manufacturing and industrialisation knowledge, excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, and a genuine curiosity for deep-tech and quantum technologies.&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply!&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;<p>Find <a href=\"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.ch\">Jobs in Switzerland<\/a> on Arbeitnow<\/a>","remote":false,"url":"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.ch\/jobs\/companies\/ionq\/product-manager-geneva-462921","tags":["Quantum Platform"],"job_types":[],"location":"Geneva","created_at":1790963708},{"slug":"principal-engineer-classical-cryptography-architecture-geneva-175045","company_name":"ionq","title":"Principal Engineer - Classical Cryptography & Architecture","description":"&lt;div class=&quot;content-intro&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About IonQ:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&amp;amp;index=7&amp;amp;md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;IonQ, Inc&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;. IonQ\u2019s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&amp;amp;index=8&amp;amp;md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Amazon Web Services, &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=and&amp;amp;index=9&amp;amp;md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;and &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=AstraZeneca&amp;amp;index=10&amp;amp;md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;AstraZeneca&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt; achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;amp;index=11&amp;amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;setting a world record in quantum computing performance&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location:&lt;\/strong&gt; This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Travel:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Job ID:&lt;\/strong&gt; 1892&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking &amp;amp; financial institutions from the \u201charvest-now, decrypt-later\u201d threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the classical cryptography architecture of our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration products, targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. Real-world quantum-safe systems are hybrid systems: classical and post-quantum algorithms operating side by side, with careful key management, crypto agility and migration paths. You will be the senior authority for this classical and hybrid layer, working alongside our PQC architecture leadership. The role demands fluency on both sides of the transition: deep classical mastery combined with a solid working command of the post-quantum algorithms and standards the products are built around.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own the architecture and implementation strategy of the classical cryptographic functions of the product line: symmetric ciphers and modes (AES\/GCM and beyond), hash functions (SHA-2\/SHA-3, HMAC\/KDF constructions), RSA\/ECC offload, and true random number generation and entropy architecture (SP 800-90A\/B\/C). You will define the hybrid classical\/post-quantum schemes (key establishment, dual signatures, composite certificates) and the crypto-agility mechanisms that allow customers to migrate safely, track the standardisation of hybrid and composite approaches (NIST guidance, IETF work on hybrid key establishment in TLS 1.3 and IKEv2, composite certificates) together with our PQC architects, guide RTL and software engineers implementing classical cores, technically evaluate third-party IP, and support FIPS 140-3 and CAVP certification of the classical algorithm suite. You will also own key-management and key-hierarchy architecture across the product, ensuring interoperability with deployed HSM, TLS and IPsec ecosystems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the classical and hybrid cryptography architecture of the product line: symmetric, hash, RSA\/ECC, entropy and key management, and classical\/PQC hybrid schemes&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define crypto-agility and migration mechanisms that let customers move to quantum-safe deployments without breaking existing infrastructure&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Master\u2019s or PhD in Cryptography, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field and at least twelve years of experience implementing and architecting classical cryptography in real products, in hardware, software or both. You have deep command of symmetric and asymmetric primitives, modes of operation, key management and entropy generation, and you have taken cryptographic subsystems through FIPS 140-3 or Common Criteria evaluation. You also bring a solid working knowledge of the NIST post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) and their deployment constraints: you do not need to be a lattice specialist, but you must be able to architect hybrid schemes with one.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You understand the practical constraints of deployed security infrastructure (HSMs, PKI, TLS and IPsec ecosystems) and how hybrid classical\/post-quantum schemes are standardised and deployed in practice. You write precise specifications, guide implementers effectively, and make sound architecture decisions under real-world interoperability constraints. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven architect of classical cryptographic subsystems with certification experience (FIPS 140-3, CAVP, Common Criteria)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Practical knowledge of hybrid classical\/PQC schemes, crypto agility and key-management architecture, with working command of the NIST PQC standards&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Qualifications:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You believe that quantum-safe security is only as strong as the classical foundations it stands on. You enjoy being the guardian of correctness and interoperability in a programme pushing new technology, and you take pride in migrations that customers barely notice because they simply work.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We Offer:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A career development plan within the IonQ group\u2019s companies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental\/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply!&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;<p>Find <a href=\"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.ch\">Jobs in Switzerland<\/a> on Arbeitnow<\/a>","remote":false,"url":"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.ch\/jobs\/companies\/ionq\/principal-engineer-classical-cryptography-architecture-geneva-175045","tags":["Quantum Platform - Network and Security"],"job_types":[],"location":"Geneva","created_at":1790963708},{"slug":"distinguished-pqc-cryptography-architecture-leader-geneva-105282","company_name":"ionq","title":"Distinguished PQC Cryptography & Architecture Leader","description":"&lt;div class=&quot;content-intro&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About IonQ:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&amp;amp;index=7&amp;amp;md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;IonQ, Inc&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location:&lt;\/strong&gt; This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Travel:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Job ID:&lt;\/strong&gt; 1891&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking &amp;amp; financial institutions from the \u201charvest-now, decrypt-later\u201d threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Distinguished Leader to provide the overall technical leadership for our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration programme, part of our quantum-safe product portfolio targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. As the most senior technical authority of the programme, you will own the end-to-end architecture, from cryptographic algorithm and standards strategy to an FPGA-based product architecture with a clear path to ASIC, and you will set the technical direction across the cryptography, hardware, software and security disciplines involved. This is a rare opportunity to shape a strategic security product line at one of the few companies where quantum-safe security is the core business.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will define the system architecture and microarchitecture of a multi-algorithm PQC accelerator implementing ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA\/LMS: hardware\/firmware partitioning, throughput and lane sizing derived from real customer traffic models, and a stable core-interface specification that lets cryptographic cores evolve behind a frozen contract. You will own the algorithm and standards strategy (NIST FIPS 203\/204\/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3), drive make\/buy and IP-licensing decisions, and shape the security and certification architecture together with our side-channel and compliance specialists. You will set the technical roadmap, arbitrate the hardest cross-domain design decisions, mentor the senior engineers who own each domain, and represent the programme externally with customers, standards bodies, certification laboratories and executive stakeholders.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the end-to-end architecture and technical roadmap of a PQC hardware-acceleration product line (algorithms, microarchitecture, interfaces, and security\/certification strategy) from concept to shipping product&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the programme\u2019s most senior technical authority: set direction across disciplines, mentor senior engineers, and represent the technology with customers, standards bodies and executives&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Master\u2019s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Cryptography or a related field and fifteen or more years of experience architecting complex digital security hardware, including deep, hands-on exposure to cryptographic implementation with genuine post-quantum depth. You are a recognised authority in your field, evidenced by shipped market-defining security products, contributions to standards, publications or patents, and you have taken accelerators, secure elements or HSM-class systems from specification to production more than once.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You are equally credible discussing lattice-based cryptography with a cryptographer, timing closure with an FPGA designer, and certification strategy with a FIPS laboratory, and you can defend an architecture in front of a demanding customer or executive committee. You make well-reasoned build\/buy\/partner decisions under uncertainty and raise the technical bar of everyone around you. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Recognised architect of cryptographic or security hardware products, with authoritative depth in PQC algorithms and standards (FIPS 203\/204\/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Distinguished-level technical leadership: sets direction across domains, mentors senior specialists, and represents the company externally&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Qualifications:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You thrive on ambiguity and ownership, turning a strategic mandate into an architecture, a plan and a working product. You lead through technical authority and clarity rather than hierarchy, you hold quality and security to an uncompromising standard, and you are motivated by building products that will help define quantum-safe infrastructure for the next decade.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;What We Offer:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A career development plan within the IonQ group\u2019s companies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental\/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers.
